purpose: Final Agency closure tranche across South Sudan, Thailand, Timor-Leste, Ukraine and the United States: preserve duplicate-identity/source gaps and accountability boundaries without manufactured equivalence.
migrationRule: An Agency counts as migrated only when its ABox record points to a dedicated Agency dossier. Identity, naming, hierarchy, evidence production and State context never create Material Participation or a governance outcome; direct/partial labels preserve repository source precision honestly.
visualRule: Derived visuals encode State context and terminate at the Agency identity boundary. Every evidence card preserves direct versus partial granularity and forbids partOf/sameAs/control/operation/participation/supplier inference.
